report.headline: Most likely cause: payment-svc - payment call timeout due to network latency or service unavailability

ranked_causes.mechanism: payment call timeout due to network latency or service unavailability

claims.text: The payment-svc is experiencing timeouts for multiple orders
Checkout-svc is attempting payment calls for orders that are timing out
The error rate is high due to payment-svc timeouts

unresolved_questions: Is the payment-svc overloaded or down?
report.next_check: Check payment-svc health metrics for latency and error rates
report.suggested_fix: (untested) Increase timeout duration for payment calls in checkout-svc
